# Assets · Motif

4 files under `assets/Motif/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for lattice-field-on-graphite.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Motif

The synthetic population: discrete points that resolve into structure at distance. `lattice-field.svg` (ink `#151a20` on transparent) and `lattice-field-on-graphite.svg` for empty states and section heads; `section-divider.svg` (ink) between report sections; `report-cover-field.svg` is the cover field on `doc-paper`. Use behind copy, never behind data.
